cloud.title: Read gateway details from Tuya
cloud.description: Use a linked Smart Home cloud project. Credentials are used only for this setup session and are not saved. No unlock command is sent. See the README for project setup.

gateway.title: Connect to the local gateway
gateway.description: Use the gateway LAN IPv4 address, device ID, 16-byte Local Key and protocol version. If a key was already imported or saved, leave it blank to keep it. This step only reads child connectivity.

select_locks.title: Select discovered locks
select_locks.description: Select compatible candidates to configure. {unsupported} other children could not be identified as the supported DP61 profile. Check compatibility before adding a lock.

no_locks.title: No new compatible locks found
no_locks.description: No unconfigured child has the required writable raw DP61 signature. Check cloud API permissions, gateway pairing and compatibility. You may enter a known supported lock manually.

manage.title: Manage locks
manage.description: Add the locks you want, then choose Save. Nothing is sent to a lock during setup.

menu_options.edit_lock: Edit a lock or its code
menu_options.remove_lock: Remove a lock from this integration

manual_lock.title: Identify a supported Bluetooth lock
manual_lock.description: Enter the exact device ID and node_id from Tuya. The node must appear in the gateway topology. Do not substitute its MAC address.

lock.title: Configure lock status and unlock code
lock.description: Confirm the supported HX201-style DP61 profile described in the README. Enter an existing eight-digit remote unlock code and member number, OR paste the Base64 value of your own successful DP61 unlock command. The payload overrides member/code fields and is not stored. Leave credentials blank for status only, or to retain a saved code. Local Key and keypad PIN are different credentials.

data.name: Lock name
data.confirm_profile: My lock uses the supported DP61 profile

data_description.state_source: Select HX201 / T1 only for the verified cabinet-lock profile. Other locks use the standard DP47 state. Changing this setting does not send a command.

remove_lock.title: Remove a lock
remove_lock.description: This removes its Home Assistant configuration when you save. It does not unpair the lock from Tuya.

error.invalid_auth: Tuya rejected the project credentials or authorization. Check the data center, credentials and authorized API services.
error.cloud_error: Cannot read Tuya device metadata. Check project linking, API permissions, subscription and gateway ID.
error.invalid_input: Check the IPv4 address, exact IDs, 16-byte Local Key and protocol version.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read local gateway topology. Check the address, Local Key, protocol, network access and other local clients.
error.no_locks_selected: Select at least one available lock.
error.duplicate_lock: This lock or child node is already configured.
error.node_not_found: The exact node_id was not reported by this gateway. Check pairing and node_id.
error.invalid_credentials: Confirm compatibility and enter eight ASCII digits with a member number from 1 to 65534, or a valid 13-byte DP61 command.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already configured. Use Reconfigure to edit it.

init.title: Polling interval
init.description: Refresh gateway connectivity and request child status every 30 to 600 seconds. State changes are also received continuously over the local connection. This never unlocks a lock.

missing_code.message: Configure an existing remote unlock code through Reconfigure, or supply code to lock.unlock.

locking_unsupported.message: This profile supports unlocking only. Physical locking is handled by the lock itself.

unlock_failed.message: Unlock could not be verified; the command may have reached the lock. Check its physical state before trying again. No automatic retry was sent.
